recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-42762; any future desire to promote extension search parameters onto resource search pages should be handled as a separate tooling or work-group policy item.
issue_request: FHIR-42762 was an Applied FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for a search parameter for the workflow-EpisodeOfCare extension and initially asking that it appear on all Event resource search parameter pages. The accepted resolution narrowed this to defining the extension search parameter and keeping visibility with the extension rather than adding it to associated resource pages.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged application commit was found in the core FHIR repository. The application is in HL7/fhir-extensions: commit 3e09554dcfed27290757c06c24ffbfc5327b7111 added input/definitions/multiple/SearchParameter-workflow-EpisodeOfCare.xml for FHIR-42762, and e4e4ee76ee0b1fd66d5ac12dc4d41f6a6443c921 corrected its description and FHIRPath expression.
additional_context: FHIR-42761 is the related no-change request that would have represented EpisodeOfCare directly on Event resources; rejecting it left workflow-episodeOfCare as the intended extension mechanism. Patient Care minutes from 2023-05-04 record the need to log a Jira to add a search parameter for the Extension Pack workflow-episodeOfCare extension, and FHIR Workflow minutes from 2023-09-25 record FHIR-42762 as Persuasive with Modification. No relevant Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. The current Extension Pack source defines SearchParameter/workflow-EpisodeOfCare with a reference expression against the workflow-episodeOfCare extension, and its 47 bases match the 47 allowed extension contexts. The core checkout has no active source SearchParameter-workflow-EpisodeOfCare artifact to edit, so adding resource-page search-parameter entries in core would contradict the final resolution.

related_jiras.note: No-change companion request that left EpisodeOfCare support on Event resources as the workflow-episodeOfCare extension rather than a direct Event.context/encounter change.
